testcase.name: every format and range performs zero repository writes and preserves the snapshot
the large history fixture exports deterministically
non representable values fail as typed invalid data
repository read failure maps to typed unexpected failure
serialization order is actual_time ascending then event id lexical, never read order
all range keeps every past event without lower bound and drops future events
range membership depends on absolute instants only, not on per-event zones or dates
serialization runs on the injected off-main dispatcher
30 day boundaries are inclusive at both ends and exclude one millisecond outside
capturedAt is normalized to epoch milliseconds once per action
90 day boundaries are inclusive at both ends and exclude one millisecond outside
repeat export with the same request and snapshot is byte identical
